source_text.body:
Turn bank statements into a Notion expense database
An agent takes dumped bank statements, asks about unclear transactions, then updates the user's expenses database in Notion.
·
Nov 19, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The person said they built this in their own app, PocketClaw. They dump bank statements into the agent, it flags transactions it is unsure about and asks a couple of clarifying questions, then writes the expenses into their Notion database; they still review the numbers themselves and do not let it pay bills.
How it went
They said the job dropped from a couple of hours a week to a few minutes of answering questions. The stated limitation is trust: they verify the totals manually and would not hand bill payment over to it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
I'm putting my bank statements in [folder path]. Read them, pull out each transaction, and categorize it using these categories: [list categories]. If a transaction is unclear, ask me about it before assigning a category. Once everything is categorized, show me a preview of the rows you plan to add to my Notion expenses database [database name], and wait for my approval before writing anything to Notion.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/AI_Agents/comments/1xzol7p/curious_what_are_you_agentifying_your_daily_life
